svg.title: Magento theme inheritance and file fallback
svg.desc: The theme PocketCoffee/roast declares Magento/luma as its parent in theme.xml, and Magento/luma declares Magento/blank. When the storefront needs a file such as Magento_Theme/templates/html/copyright.phtml it looks in the active theme first, then in each parent in turn, then in the module's own view/frontend folder, and uses the first file found. Layout XML files are different: every theme in the chain contributes its file and they are merged. LESS partials follow the same fallback, and a child file with the same name as the parent's replaces it as a whole.
svg.text: A child theme only holds what differs; everything else is found upwards

g.text: Templates, images, JavaScript, LESS partials: the first file found wins
found in step 1 (the child overrides the template): used.
not in 1, not in 2, not in 3: the module's own file is used.
Luma has one; a file of that name in the child replaces it as a whole,
so the child must copy it, or put its overrides in _extend.less instead.
Layout XML: every level contributes, nothing is replaced
Magento_Theme/layout/default.xml is read from the module, then from Blank,
then from Luma, then from PocketCoffee/roast, and the results are merged.
To replace one, use the same file name under Magento_Theme/layout/override/theme/
Magento/luma/ in the child theme; it replaces that ancestor's file.
Changing a parent file in vendor/ is never the answer: it is lost on the
next composer update. Override it in the child theme.
A theme.xml parent is resolved by path (Vendor/name), never by the title.
